messages:
mira: quick check on roles panel prototype — thinking about collapsing the permissions legend into a small pill and moving the SSO toggle into the security row to save vertical space. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/roles-proto
devin: compact pill seems good but worried about discoverability. can we surface it on first-run or add a tiny '?' helper next to 'Roles'? :thinking:
arpita: accessibility note: current blue role pills at 12px fail 4.5:1 contrast. either bump contrast token or use bolder text. also keyboard focus ring is missing in mock.
jonah: audit navigation idea: instead of a tiny chevron, show a small 'jump to audit' button (eye icon) next to changed attributes that opens audit drawer filtered to ?event=role_change. must be tabbable with aria-label.
mira: love the audit filter idea. copy candidates to standardize: ['Permissions legend','Invite member','Require SSO for this org','Jump to audit entry']
qa-bot: accessibility checklist reminder: keyboard focus states, aria-labels for collapsed legend, contrast ratios, tooltip delays. run NVDA/VoiceOver smoke tests.
mira: i'll update color tokens, add keyboard styles, lazy-render the audit button on hover/focus, and push a new figma + short checklist here. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
